admission.repository: candidate until the meta-injector owner accepts ADR-086
admission.consumer: not admitted; l9-constellation-topology owns interpretation and reconciliation
admission.semantic_foundation: not Foundation-governed; neither depends on nor implies admission of the v3.27.0 binding

writers.source: src/normalize_meta.ts buildMeta, used by inject, apply and check
writers.writes: every vocabulary field except as variants says

writers.source: src/inventory.ts inventoryTree with purpose annotate and headers enabled
writers.writes: every vocabulary field except family and owner, which it never derives; a family or owner harvested from an earlier header is preserved

claim.object: the declared scalar value as decoded text: the reader removes YAML quoting and decodes escapes, so the object is the value, not its lexical form

meaning.declaration_only: A field states what the managed header declares about the artifact that carries it. It does not establish that the statement is true, current or authoritative.
meaning.projection_prohibition: No field may be projected into a canonical entity, relationship, identity, ownership, capability or canonical status. A consumer may index, query, compare and reconcile these claims; it may not promote them.
meaning.subject_scope: artifact: the file that carries the managed header
meaning.cardinality: single: the producer writes one managed declaration per artifact and one value per field. A second value or a second declaration for the same artifact is a competing claim; the producer does not choose between them.

unresolved_and_out_of_vocabulary.unresolved: Any key, in the vocabulary or not, declared as Unknown, empty, ~ or null states no value. It arrives as meta.managed.unresolved_field with the key as object, never as a field predicate and never as the value "Unknown". The reader decides this before it consults the vocabulary.
unresolved_and_out_of_vocabulary.out_of_vocabulary: A key outside this vocabulary that declares a value arrives as meta.managed.unsupported_field with the key as object. It carries no vocabulary meaning.

written_outside_vocabulary.harvested: The inventory writer also preserves any key harvested from an earlier header. A preserved key outside this vocabulary arrives as meta.managed.unsupported_field like any other.

authority_name_distinction.header_field_authority: meta.managed.governance.authority: an attribution label the producer records, naming who it treats as answerable for the header. It is the bound product.owner of .l9/meta-authority.yaml (schema v2); unbound, it is the operator-supplied value (annotate writer) or a harvested value or Unknown (inventory writer).
authority_name_distinction.claim_level_authority: The authority of the claim itself is always source, for every field including this one. A header is the file speaking for itself.
authority_name_distinction.global_authority_model: l9.authority-model/global@1 governs authority classes and precedence across the constellation. The header field is not an authority class, grants none and is not interpreted under that model.

variants.description: Which artifact_type values the annotate writer gives family and owner. The inventory writer derives neither (see writers). Every other field is written by both writers.

writer_invariants.description: Relations both writers maintain when they derive artifact_type. When the inventory writer cannot read the body to classify it, it writes Unknown for artifact_type and the four taxonomy fields, which arrive unresolved. A header can be edited after it is written, so a reader receives these relations as claims: a violation is evidence for the consumer to reconcile, not a value to correct.

fields.semantics: A producer-local identifier for the artifact. The annotate writer writes <namespace>.<primitive folder>.<file stem>; the inventory writer writes inv-<first 16 hex digits of the hash of the repository-relative path>. Neither is a constellation identity coordinate, and the two writers' ids for the same file differ.
Human-readable presentation text, not a governed name. The annotate writer derives it from the file basename; the inventory writer keeps a harvested title or uses the file name.

The namespace the producer assigned: the bound product.id under a v2 binding. Unbound, the annotate writer uses the operator, namespace-glob or folder default, and the inventory writer keeps a harvested namespace or writes Unknown.
The repository-relative POSIX path of the carrier when the header was written. It can be stale after a move; where the artifact is now is the consumer's observation, not this field.
The producer's heuristic classification of the artifact's primitive kind. "unknown" is a value (unclassified), distinct from an unresolved field.

fields.presence: annotate writer: artifact_type in variants.family, absent otherwise. inventory writer: only when preserved from an earlier header
fields.semantics: The producer's keyword-signal classification of an executable or retrievable artifact's functional family. An undetected family is written as Unknown and arrives unresolved.
The MCP primitive the declared artifact_type maps to under the producer's primitive taxonomy.
The primitive taxonomy's callable flag for the declared artifact_type: whether the producer treats artifacts of that type as invocable capabilities. It grants no capability.
Whether the producer treats the artifact as retrievable context. Written equal to injectable.
The primitive taxonomy's injectable flag for the declared artifact_type: whether the producer treats artifacts of that type as eligible for context injection.

An attribution label; see authority_name_distinction. Unbound, the inventory writer keeps a harvested value or writes Unknown. It is not claim authority, not an l9.authority-model class, and grants no ownership or precedence.

fields.presence: annotate writer: artifact_type in variants.owner, absent otherwise. inventory writer: only when preserved from an earlier header
fields.semantics: The bound product.owner, recorded on test, script and source artifacts. Unbound, it is written as Unknown and arrives unresolved. It grants no ownership.
The producer's sharing classification, from shared and private signal words in the path of a prose-format file. Code and configuration files are always agnostic.
